# SLGaussian: Fast Language Gaussian Splatting in Sparse Views

> Builds 3D semantic fields from two RGB views without per-scene optimization and supports fast open-vocabulary 3D object querying and segmentation.

## Paper and project

- [Research summary](https://chenkangjie1123.github.io/SLGaussian/index.md): Author-written abstract, authors, venue, and source links.
- [Project page](https://chenkangjie1123.github.io/SLGaussian/): Original figures, results, and BibTeX.
- [arXiv paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.08331): Full research paper.
- [Code](https://github.com/chenkangjie1123/SLGaussian): Project repository.
